final_message:
Configured the requested names and both MX records using the lab’s existing IPv4 addresses. All 40 PCs now use the resolver on **pc34** (`10.15.9.12`).

The artificial root is on pc1; pc2–pc5 serve the top-level zones; pc6, pc8–pc10, pc12–pc15, pc21, pc32 and pc33 serve the delegated zones. Existing connections, addresses, routes and images were left unchanged.

The configuration files and PC startup scripts have been updated. Dynamic DNS validation was not run, and `named-checkzone` and `named-checkconf` were unavailable locally. The MX records identify the mail hosts; they do not configure mail delivery services.
